correlate.executive_summary: The assessment discovered missing and inconsistent HTTP security headers on https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com/, which reduces the application's resilience to client-side attacks (e.g. clickjacking, MIME sniffing, and weaker transport hardening). The host is running on Heroku (heroku-router / Server: Heroku) and includes Heroku-specific reporting/monitoring headers (report-to, nel, reporting-endpoints) that point to nel.heroku.com. No product/version data was available for CVE matching, and no version-specific CVEs were identified for the detected platform. Recommendations: add appropriate HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options (or equivalent CSP frame-ancestors), Content-Security-Policy, and Referrer-Policy headers as part of standard HTTP hardening, and review any telemetry endpoints for privacy/policy needs.
